name: Mikal J. Stole
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Joliet, Illinois
about: Mikal J. Stole is an attorney at Reich, Jumbeck, Stole & Reeb, in Joliet, Illinois. Mr. Stole focuses his practice on family law and serves clients throughout Will County, Illinois. He handles cases involving divorce, high net worth and business related divorce, child support, parenting matters, prenuptial agreements and other family law issues.

Over his more than 15 years in practice, Mr. Stole has helped and supported many Illinois residents as they have resolved their unique family law issues. He understands that the family law process is complicated and guides his clients each step of the way, always working with their best interests in mind.

When negotiation is not possible, Mr. Stole is ready and able to fight for his clients in a courtroom. In addition to representing private parties, he serves as a guardian ad litem, representing the best interests of the children involved in family law proceedings.

Mr. Stole regularly lectures on family law topics such as contempt of court, ethics and guardian ad litem matters at continuing legal education seminars. He holds several leadership roles in the Will County Bar Association, serving as chair of the Family Committee and the parenting class program, as well as on the Board of Directors. He also serves on the Will County domestic relations local court rules committee.

After graduating from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign with a bachelor’s degree, Mr. Stole earned his law degree from Chicago’s John Marshall Law School, now known as the University of Illinois Chicago School of Law. He is licensed to practice law before the state courts of Illinois and the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Illinois.
